34:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') ship.movingRight = true;
35:   });
36:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
37:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') ship.movingLeft = false;
38:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') ship.movingRight = false;
39:   });
40: 
41:   function spawnAsteroid() {
42:     const radius = Math.random() * 15 + 10;
43:     const x = Math.random() * (width - radius * 2) + radius;
44:     const speed = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
45:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -radius, radius, speed });
46:   }
47: 
48:   function update(delta) {
49:     if (gameOver) return;

52:     if (ship.movingRight) ship.x = Math.min(width - ship.width, ship.x + ship.speed);
53: 
54:     // Spawn asteroids
55:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn.time > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
56:       spawnAsteroid();
57:       lastSpawn.time = performance.now();
58:     }
59: 
60:     // Update asteroids
61:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
62:       const a = asteroids[i];
63:       a.y += a.speed;

65:       const shipRect = { x: ship.x, y: ship.y, w: ship.width, h: ship.height };
66:       const distX = Math.abs(a.x - (shipRect.x + shipRect.w / 2));

68:       if (distX > (shipRect.w / 2 + a.radius) || distY > (shipRect.h / 2 + a.radius)) {
69:         // no collision
70:       } else {
71:         // collision detected
72:         gameOver = true;
73:       }
74:       // Remove off‑screen asteroids and increment score
75:       if (a.y - a.radius > height) {
76:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
77:         score++;
78:       }
79:     }
80:   }
81: 
82:   function draw() {
83:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
84: 
85:     // Draw ship
86:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00f';
87:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.width, ship.height);
88: 
89:     // Draw asteroids
90:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
91:     for (const a of asteroids) {
92:       ctx.beginPath();
93:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
94:       ctx.fill();
95:     }
96: 
97:     // Draw score
98:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
99:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';

107:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
108:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
109:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
110:     }
111:   }
112: 
113:   let lastTime = 0;
114:   function loop(timestamp) {
115:     const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
116:     lastTime = timestamp;
117:     update(delta);
118:     draw();
119:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
120:   }
121: 
122:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
123: })();
